title: James Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on James 1: joy in testing, asking God for wisdom, the rich man like a flower, and being doers of the word.

questions.text: To whom is the letter addressed in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion.

answers.text: To the twelve tribes in the Dispersion
To the elders in Jerusalem
To the rich men of the city
To those who teach the law

questions.text: What does the testing of your faith produce, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says to count it all joy, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

answers.text: Wisdom
Riches
Endurance
Knowledge

questions.text: What should someone who lacks wisdom do?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says that if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

answers.text: Ask the elders of the assembly
Ask of God, who gives to all liberally
Wait quietly until it is given
Search the law to find it

questions.text: What is the one who doubts compared to?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says to ask in faith without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

answers.text: A flower in the grass
A man looking in a mirror
A withered field of grain
A wave of the sea, driven by the wind

questions.text: What is the rich man compared to in verses 10 and 11?
questions.explanation: Verses 10 and 11 say the rich man is like the flower in the grass, which falls when the sun arises with the scorching wind, and so he will fade away in his pursuits.

answers.text: The flower in the grass that passes away
A wave driven about by the wind
A tree planted beside water
A mirror that shows no face

questions.text: What will the person who endures temptation receive?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says that blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

answers.text: A new name
The crown of life
A better resurrection
The land of promise

questions.text: What does verse 15 say sin produces when it is full grown?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says that the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin, and the sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

answers.text: Sorrow
Weakness
Death
Judgment

questions.text: Where does every good gift and every perfect gift come from?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation.

answers.text: From the perfect law of freedom
From the implanted word of truth
From the hands of the elders of the tribes
From above, from the Father of lights

questions.text: What is someone who hears the word but does not do it compared to?
questions.explanation: Verses 23 and 24 say such a person is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror, who goes away and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

answers.text: A man who looks in a mirror and forgets his face
A flower withered by the scorching wind
A builder who leaves his house unfinished
A traveller who loses the way at night

questions.text: What does verse 27 call pure and undefiled religion before God and the Father?
questions.explanation: Verse 27 says pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

answers.text: To offer gifts in the synagogue each week
To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction
To teach the law to the twelve tribes
To keep silence before the elders
